messages:
nina: hey everyone, first week and trying to finish cloud setup. running into two things: i can't create a service account key (403) and when i try to make a GKE cluster in asia-northeast1 i get a region restriction. also i don't see a billing account to link the project. who should i ask?

samir: welcome @nina! can you paste the exact errors?

nina: SA error from gcloud: 
```
ERROR: (gcloud.iam.service-accounts.keys.create) PERMISSION_DENIED: Permission iam.serviceAccountKeys.create denied on resource project 234567890123.
Details: Policy 'constraints/iam.disableServiceAccountKeyCreation' enforced at folder level.
```
GKE error: 
```
ERROR: The project is not allowed to create resources in region asia-northeast1 due to org policy constraints/compute.restrictRegions.
```
Billing shows "No billing account linked" and the link button is greyed out.

ops: thanks for the details. sounds like your project landed in a restricted folder. filing INFRA-9433 to: 1) move project to onboarding-sandbox folder, 2) attach billingAccounts/4444-3333-2222, 3) grant you roles/iam.serviceAccountAdmin and roles/billing.projectManager for onboarding. ETA ~30-60m. tagging infra and security for region exceptions if needed.

samir: quick check  are you planning to run any customer-prod data in asia? security needs to sign off for region expansion.

nina: no customer data, only sample datasets for demos.

infra-bot: Org policy scan: project 234567890123 denies SA key creation and limits allowed compute regions to [us-central1, europe-west1]. Ticket INFRA-9433 created and assigned to ops.

nina: thanks. one more: our terraform backend needs an AWS assume-role into rdw-infra account but i don't see the role in AWS SSO to switch to. terraform apply fails with assume-role denied.

sso-bot: please submit an SSO access request with target role arn:aws:iam::333444555666:role/rdw-terraform and include your Okta email. If your Okta lacks the infra-dev group the request will be pending until ops adds you. Typical approver group: infra-approvers.

ops: noted. i'll add an Okta group action to INFRA-9433 to ensure "infra-dev" membership and create the SSO mapping so REQ-68102 auto-approves. please attach REQ id here when you submit the SSO request.

nina: submitted SSO REQ-68102 and updated INFRA-9433. thanks for the fast help!

samir: great. ping here once INFRA-9433 is closed and REQ-68102 is approved and we'll mark onboarding as complete. :party-parrot:
